status_observed: 200, but the generated PDF prints the letter "n" where the currency symbol should be
what_is_wrong: Every money amount in the generated offer/appointment/resignation-acceptance letter PDF renders as "n45,000.00" instead of "Rs 45,000.00". The PDF is built with the base-14 Helvetica font under WinAnsiEncoding, which has no glyph for U+20B9; ReportLab silently substitutes byte 0x6E ('n'). The letter is emailed to the employee as an official document, so the defect is customer-visible.
